title: execution_result
description: Schema for execution_result_NNNN.json artefacts mirroring claude --print --output-format json payload (Initiative_Orchestrator_Spec_v1_4 §5.2 + Phase 0 Test 6). Phase 4a P4-06. NOTE (updated 2026-05-26 by FUP-0733 + FUP-0737): root additionalProperties is true (FUP-0733 flipped 2026-05-26 to accept real claude envelope fields like api_error_status / modelUsage / ttft_ms / uuid); permission_denials.items.required uses anyOf [tool | tool_name] to accept BOTH the original synthetic-fixture shape ({tool, reason}) AND the real claude --output-format json shape ({tool_name, tool_use_id, tool_input, reason}) — see FUP-0737. items.additionalProperties remains true; required keys enumerated via anyOf, not bare required[]; surface any unrelated future shape drift as Phase Z (do NOT re-tighten without re-verifying against current claude CLI output).

result.description: Final text output from the session.

total_cost_usd.description: Cumulative USD spend for the session.

permission_denials.description: Per-permission denial records. Non-empty array fails §10.5 FR-019 post-execution gate.

tool.description: Legacy synthetic-fixture shape (pre-FUP-0737). Optional now; either `tool` or `tool_name` must be present (anyOf).

tool_name.description: Real claude --output-format json shape (added 2026-05-26 per FUP-0737). Either `tool` or `tool_name` must be present (anyOf).

tool_use_id.description: Real claude shape companion to tool_name. Optional.

tool_input.description: Real claude shape companion to tool_name; the input args that were attempted. Optional.

terminal_reason.description: Termination cause. §10.5 FR-019 requires `completed` to pass the post-execution gate.

duration_api_ms.description: Optional API-call cumulative duration in ms.

is_error.description: Optional error flag from claude CLI.
